correctness.rationale: The exact edge-pair CDF decomposition is valid for each unit-edge tree; induction shows N_k(T) <= binom(m-k,2) for every integer k. Monotonicity of the uniform-sum CDF gives FSD at every real threshold. Branching coefficient, equality uniqueness, Q cut sum, W1 and the optimal m-2 nonstar gap are derived analytically; exhaustive finite Prüfer checks and independently reconstructed endpoint routes agree. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Stochastic order over every topology of a fixed-size equilateral metric tree determines comparisons for all nondecreasing travel penalties, rather than only the previously known mean. The exact CDF t^2 coefficient reveals branching, and a sharp W1 separation uniquely identifies the nearest nonstar topology. This constitutes a natural all-sizes exact extremal classification with quantitative stability.
